import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    a=[row[:] for row in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (max(set(x for rr in grid for x in rr), key=lambda x:sum(rr.count(x) for rr in grid)),)]
    # The repeated marker is the less common color; fill its bounding rectangle.
    colors={v for row in grid for v in row}
    bg=max(colors,key=lambda x:sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    fg=next(v for v in colors if v!=bg)
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==fg]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            if a[r][c]==bg: a[r][c]=2
    return a
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
